The function |forget-macromemos/|| is defined as a subr in
the current Macsyma.  I don't know how it got in there since
it should only be autoloaded from LISP;DEFMAX and shouldn't
be needed by Macsyma at runtime.  Its presence is also causing
DEFMACRO to lose since LISP;DEFMAC uses this to determine when
to load DEFMAX.
